frontmatter.title: Image generation tool
frontmatter.lead: Add image generation and image editing to a Fusion model so a text model can produce image assets directly.

frontmatter.title: Video generation tool
frontmatter.lead: Add text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-to-video capability to a Fusion model through asynchronous video jobs.

frontmatter.title: Install and start CCR
frontmatter.lead: Choose among the desktop app, npm CLI, and Docker distributions, complete installation and first startup, and verify the management UI and model gateway addresses. The CLI requires Node.js 22 or newer.

frontmatter.title: 生图工具
frontmatter.lead: 在 Fusion 模型中加入图片生成和图片编辑能力，让文本模型可以直接产出图片资产。

frontmatter.title: 生视频工具
frontmatter.lead: 在 Fusion 模型中加入文本生视频、图生视频和参考图生视频能力，并通过异步任务返回视频产物。

frontmatter.title: 安装并启动 CCR
frontmatter.lead: 按运行场景在桌面应用、npm CLI 和 Docker 三种发行方式中选择并完成安装，然后验证管理界面与模型网关地址。CLI 要求 Node.js 22 或更高版本。

frontmatter.lead: The interactive panel at the top of this page connects to your running CCR to add a provider directly. Prefer the desktop app? frontmatter.title: 自定义 MCP 工具

frontmatter.title: Claude Code Router detailed configuration
frontmatter.lead: Detailed configuration is split into standalone pages that follow the app's own order, covering the overview dashboard, providers, Agent Config, API keys, logs and observability, and server, plus the config database and tray pages under settings. AgentClaw, Fusion, ToolHub, routing, import, and extensions are documented as standalone top-level sections.

frontmatter.title: Built-in vision
frontmatter.lead: Give a non-multimodal model visual ability, for example GLM-5.2 + GLM-5V-Turbo = GLM-5.2V.

frontmatter.title: Built-in web search
frontmatter.lead: Add live web retrieval to a model with CCR's built-in web_search capability, backed by In-app Browser or a search service such as Brave, Bing, or Tavily.

frontmatter.title: Logs and observability
frontmatter.lead: This page is the configuration reference for logging and observability: configure Request logs and Agent observability to inspect request details, execution traces, tool calls, tool results, and performance. For first-run verification of the pipeline, see [Enable logging and observability](../../guides/observability/).

frontmatter.title: Server
frontmatter.lead: Configure the CCR gateway host, port, and Proxy mode for MITM interception and proxying into CCR.

frontmatter.title: Tray configuration
frontmatter.lead: Configure the CCR system tray icon, balance progress, and tray window widgets.

frontmatter.title: Claude Code Router 详细配置
frontmatter.lead: 详细配置按应用内的实际顺序拆成独立页面，覆盖概览、供应商、Agent 配置、API 密钥、日志与可观测性、服务，以及设置中的配置数据库和托盘。AgentClaw、Fusion、ToolHub、智能路由、一键导入和扩展在顶部一级目录单独说明。

frontmatter.title: 内置图像能力
frontmatter.lead: 让不支持多模态的模型拥有视觉能力，例如 GLM-5.2 + GLM-5V-Turbo = GLM-5.2V。

frontmatter.title: 内置联网搜索
frontmatter.lead: 为不支持联网的模型添加实时检索能力：选择 CCR 内置 web_search 能力，并配置 In-app Browser 或 Brave、Bing、Tavily 等搜索服务。

frontmatter.title: 日志与可观测性
frontmatter.lead: 本页是日志与观测相关开关和面板能力的配置参考：在设置中开启请求日志和 Agent 观测，查看请求明细，并分析 Agent 的执行链路和性能。首次接入后验证链路是否生效，见 [开启日志与观测](../../guides/observability/)。

frontmatter.title: 服务配置
frontmatter.lead: 配置 CCR 网关监听地址、端口，以及通过代理模式进行 MITM 劫持并代理到 CCR 的能力。
